sources.observation: Affiliate commissions are included in X's definition of paid partnerships, and adult or sexual products and services are listed as a prohibited industry for paid-partnership promotion.

Consensually produced adult media may be posted when properly labeled, but adult media is restricted from highly visible profile areas. This policy does not affirmatively clear affiliate promotion or a DATA LAB profile website field.

X's paid advertising policy prohibits promotion of adult sexual content globally. The page states that it applies to monetization on X and paid advertising products, so it is not treated as direct approval or prohibition for every organic, link-free DATA LAB aggregate post.
